mcqs.learning_point: Understand the cell as the basic unit of life
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements best defines a cell as the basic unit of life?

options.A: The smallest part of an organism that can survive independently outside the body.
options.B: A group of similar tissues that perform a specific function.
options.C: The smallest structural and functional unit that can carry out all life processes.
options.D: A membrane-bound compartment that stores genetic material only.

mcqs.answer: The smallest structural and functional unit that can carry out all life processes.
mcqs.explanation: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of life, meaning it can perform all activities necessary for life. Option A describes an organ, B describes a tissue, and D is too narrow because cells also have many functions besides storing genetic material.

mcqs.learning_point: State the basic ideas of cell theory
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is NOT a component of the classical cell theory?

options.A: All living organisms are composed of one or more cells.
options.B: The cell is the basic unit of structure and function in living organisms.
options.C: All cells arise from pre‑existing cells.
options.D: All cells are derived from non‑living matter.

mcqs.answer: All cells are derived from non‑living matter.
mcqs.explanation: The three accepted statements of the cell theory are A, B, and C. Statement D contradicts the third tenet, which says cells arise only from pre‑existing cells, not from non‑living matter.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an example of a multicellular organism?
mcqs.explanation: Humans are composed of many specialized cells forming tissues and organs, making them multicellular. Amoeba, Paramecium, and E. coli are all unicellular organisms.

mcqs.question: A plant cell is observed to contain a large number of mitochondria. Which cellular activity is most likely to be especially high in this cell?
mcqs.explanation: Mitochondria are the powerhouses of the cell; a high number indicates a demand for large amounts of ATP, i.e., high metabolic activity. Protein synthesis occurs in ribosomes, photosynthesis in chloroplasts, and rapid movement depends on the cytoskeleton.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the cell as the basic unit of life
mcqs.question: True or False: All living organisms are made up of many cells.

options.C: Both true and false depending on the organism

mcqs.explanation: The statement is false because many organisms, such as bacteria and many protists, consist of a single cell (unicellular). Only multicellular organisms have many cells.

mcqs.learning_point: State the basic ideas of cell theory
mcqs.question: The discovery of prokaryotic cells (which lack a nucleus) challenged which common misconception about the cell theory?

options.A: That all cells contain a nucleus.
options.B: That cells are the basic unit of life.
options.C: That all cells arise from pre‑existing cells.
options.D: That living organisms are composed of one or more cells.

mcqs.answer: That all cells contain a nucleus.
mcqs.explanation: Early interpretations of the cell theory sometimes implied that every cell has a nucleus. Prokaryotes showed that cells can function without a nucleus, correcting this misconception while leaving the other three tenets unchanged.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly compares unicellular and multicellular organisms?

options.A: Unicellular organisms have specialized tissues, whereas multicellular organisms do not.
options.B: Multicellular organisms can perform all life processes within a single cell, unlike unicellular organisms.
options.C: Multicellular organisms consist of many cells that often differentiate for specific functions, while unicellular organisms perform all functions within one cell.
options.D: Both unicellular and multicellular organisms always reproduce by binary fission.

mcqs.answer: Multicellular organisms consist of many cells that often differentiate for specific functions, while unicellular organisms perform all functions within one cell.
mcqs.explanation: Option C accurately reflects that multicellular organisms have differentiated cells for specialized tasks, whereas unicellular organisms must carry out all life processes within a single cell. Options A, B, and D are incorrect.

mcqs.question: A scientist isolates a cell that has an extensive network of rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) and numerous ribosomes attached to it. Which function is this cell most likely specialized for?

options.B: Production of large quantities of proteins for secretion

mcqs.answer: Production of large quantities of proteins for secretion
mcqs.explanation: The rough ER, studded with ribosomes, is the site of synthesis of proteins destined for secretion or for use in the cell membrane. Lipid synthesis occurs mainly in smooth ER, photosynthesis in chloroplasts, and rapid division is linked to the nucleus and mitotic apparatus.
